summary: The filing reports a board resolution by KB Financial Group Inc. to acquire 3,811,944 common shares (KRW 600 billion estimated amount) on the KRX via KB Securities, during April 24, 2026 to July 20, 2026, at the prior day's closing price of KRW 157,400 per share. The purpose is to enhance shareholder return and corporate value through acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares. The daily purchase limit is 381,194 shares, subject to volume constraints. A limitation on acquisition amount is KRW 2.555 trillion. This is a domestic ordinary share buyback, not a tender offer. Watch execution pace and any cancellation timeline.
